verdict.rationale: The only workflow-automation evidence is a Shopify Flow-powered low-stock notification that fires on sales-rate thresholds, plus a generic claim of low-code/no-code customization. That shows event-triggered automation tied to POS, but nothing documents scheduling recurring jobs or time-based workflows. Missing for 10: any documented scheduled or recurring trigger capability, details of Flow workflow configuration for POS, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
